Class ReportData

java.lang.Object
com.example.export.ReportData
public class ReportData extends Object
Author:
Ubayd Razack Works out everything the PDF report shows. The PDF maker only draws the values, so all the calculations can be unit tested here.

  • Method Details

    • calculateIdleMillis

      private static long calculateIdleMillis(List<TelemetryEvent> events, SessionInfo session)
      Adds up the time between each IDLE_START and the following IDLE_END. An idle period still open at the end of the session counts up to the session's end. The total is never more than the session's length.
      Parameters:
      events - the session's events, sorted by time
      session - the session's details
      Returns:
      the total idle time in milliseconds

    • countErrors

      private static Map<String,Integer> countErrors(List<TelemetryEvent> events)
      Counts how many times each compiler error message occurred.
      Parameters:
      events - the session's events
      Returns:
      each message and its count, most frequent first, ties in alphabetical order
